sqlMap.update: UPDATE KEP_COURIER_MNG SET IF_FLAG = 'T' WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE KEP_COURIER_MNG A SET IF_FLAG = 'D' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'T' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM WMSIVDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND INV_NO = A.INV_NO AND STATUS != 'D')
sqlMap.select:
SELECT BUYER , INV_NO , BOX_SEQ , COURIER_NO , nvl(SENDER_POINT_CODE,' ') AS SENDER_POINT_CODE , nvl(SENDER_POINT_NAME,' ') AS SENDER_POINT_NAME , nvl(SENDER_NAME,' ') AS SENDER_NAME , nvl(SENDER_PHONE_NUMBER,' ') AS SENDER_PHONE_NUMBER , nvl(SENDER_ZIP_CODE,' ') AS SENDER_ZIP_CODE , nvl(SENDER_ADDRESS,' ') AS SENDER_ADDRESS , nvl(RECEIVER_POINT_CODE,' ') AS RECEIVER_POINT_CODE , nvl(RECEIVER_POINT_NAME,' ') AS RECEIVER_POINT_NAME , nvl(ADD_USER_ID,' ') AS ADD_USER_ID
FROM KEP_COURIER_MNG WHERE IF_FLAG = 'T' ORDER BY BUYER, INV_NO, BOX_SEQ, COURIER_NO

SELECT F.COM_NAME_LOC AS RECEIVER_COMPANY , E.USER_NAME_LOC AS RECEIVER_NAME , E.PHONE_NUMBER AS RECEIVER_TEL1 , SUBSTR(C.DELY_TO_LOCATION,1,6) AS RECEIVE_ZIP_CODE , TRIM(SUBSTR(C.DELY_TO_LOCATION,7,LENGTHB(C.DELY_TO_LOCATION))) AS RECEIVE_ADDRESS , '전기자재류' AS ITEM_NAME , substrb(c.PO_REMARK,1,30) AS REMARK1 , nvl(CHANGE_USER_MOBILE_PHONE,' ') AS RECEIVE_TEL2 , TO_CHAR(#READ_CNT#,'FM00000') AS SEND_SEQ , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS SEND_DATE , NVL(#COURIER_NO#, ' ') AS COURIER_NO , '104100004' AS KEP_ID , ' ' AS KEY_1 , #INV_NO#|| '-' || #BOX_SEQ# AS PO_NO , '1' AS BOX_QTY , '100000' AS UNIT_PRICE , ' ' AS KEY_2 , NVL(#SENDER_NAME#, ' ') AS SENDER_COMPANY_NM , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #ADD_USER_ID#) AS SENDER_NAME , NVL(#SENDER_PHONE_NUMBER#,' ') AS SENDER_TEL1 , ' ' AS SENDER_TEL2 , NVL(#SENDER_ZIP_CODE#, ' ') AS SENDER_ZIP_CODE , NVL(#SENDER_ADDRESS#, ' ') AS SENDER_ADDRESS , NVL(#SENDER_POINT_CODE#, ' ') AS COURIER_CODE , NVL(#RECEIVER_POINT_CODE#, ' ') AS ILYANG_OFFICE_CD , ' ' AS SP_NOTE , '01' AS PAYMENT_TYPE , '01' AS PAYMENT_CD , ' ' AS BOX_NOTE , '10' AS BOX_WEIGHT , ' ' AS SEND_FARE , '01' AS SEND_TYPE FROM WMSIVDT A, ICOMPODT B, ICOMPOHD C, ICOMPRDT D, ICOMLUSR E, ICOMCMPY F, ICOMPRHD G WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND C.STATUS != 'D' AND B.BUYER = D.BUYER AND B.PR_NO = D.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ = D.PR_SEQ AND D.STATUS != 'D' AND D.REQ_USER_ID = E.USER_ID AND C.BUYER = E.COM_CODE AND E.COM_CODE = F.COM_CODE AND D.BUYER = G.BUYER AND D.PR_NO = G.PR_NO AND ROWNUM = 1
sqlMap.update: UPDATE KEP_COURIER_MNG SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND BOX_SEQ = #BOX_SEQ# AND COURIER_NO = #COURIER_NO#
